newsitem.title: USA: House to act on Barshefsky bill Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: House to act on Barshefsky bill Tuesday.

text.p: The House of Representatives has scheduled action Tuesday on a bill granting a waiver to U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky from a law barring anyone from the post if they have represented a foreign government on trade matters.

Barshefsky was confirmed by the Senate last Wednesday, 99-1, but needs the waiver passed before she can be sworn in because she represented Canadian lumber interests while working as a Washington lawyer. She has been acting USTR since last summer. The Senate passed the waiver Wednesday, 98-2.
